title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
statement: Given tokens for a valid arithmetic expression in Reverse Polish Notation, evaluate the expression.
Operators are +, -, *, and /. Division between integers truncates toward zero.
constraints: tokens[i] is an operator or an integer in range [-200, 200].
The input is a valid Reverse Polish Notation expression.
All intermediate and final results fit in a 32-bit signed integer.

followUpDirections.direction: Ask the candidate to restate the inputs, outputs, constraints, and ambiguities.
Ask the candidate to choose and trace an ordinary example and a boundary case.
Ask for the candidate's approach, correctness argument, and complexity.
Ask the candidate to implement their stated approach and explain major decisions.
Ask the candidate to predict useful cases and expected results before running them.
Ask for complexity, an uncovered edge case, and a justified optimization or cleanup.
